messages:
claire: Heads-up: finance found ~17 invoices where applied credits disagree between Stripe and NetSuite by small amounts (mostly $0.01-$0.20). Looks like currency rounding + duplicate partial refunds. Filing here.

hamid: Can you paste a sample invoice id and amounts?

claire: Sample: stripe invoice in_9Fv12 total=120.45 refunds applied sum=20.00 net due=100.45; NetSuite shows credit 19.99 -> ns balance 100.46. Small per-invoice but ~17 customers -> ~2.83 total discrepancy.

finance-bot: [auto] mismatch-detect count=17 total_discrepancy=2.83 sample_ids=[in_9Fv12,in_3Zx88]

jules: Two hypotheses: 1) our refund-apply math truncates to cents differently for multi-currency accounts, 2) webhook duplicate partial refunds caused double-apply then reversed leaving off-cent rounding.

hamid: We rolled a change to refund normalization last week (payments PR#621). That added per-line rounding and a fallback path for minor fractions. Could be related.

ops-bot: [auto] ingest-log: recent deploy payments@v1.4.3 at 2026-02-20T02:10:00Z by hamid

claire: I grabbed raw Stripe event for in_9Fv12: `refunds: [{id: re_1A, amount: 1000, currency: usd}, {id: re_1B, amount: 100, currency: usd}] total_refunded=1100 -> $11.00` but NetSuite shows $10.99 applied.

jules: Strange. Check our cents->dollars conversion path and any integer division. Also check if one refund used invoice-level vs line-level application which triggers different rounding.

hamid: Quick grep: payments service uses `Math.floor(amount_cents / 100)` in one branch (bug) and `amount_cents / 100` in another. That floor would drop fractions. Oof.

claire: That would explain - but why only on 17 invoices? Maybe only invoices with multiple partial refunds hit the branch.

ops-bot: [auto] s3 path of suppressed/dlq events for window s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/archive/2026-02-20/ contains 21 refund events matching our sample set

jules: Plan: 1) patch payments to use consistent rounding (round to nearest cent using bankers rounding), PR incoming, 2) run a reconciliation backfill to correct affected NetSuite records, 3) add unit test for multi-refund rounding.

hamid: I'll open PR for fix and include migration note. Also add monitoring for per-invoice rounding delta > $0.05.

claire: For backfill: can we synthesize corrected apply events and replay? Finance wants minimal disturbance. We'll produce a CSV of stripe_refund -> corrected_amount -> ns_candidate and ask for accounting sign-off before applying.

ops-bot: [auto] replay-tool available: tools/replay_refunds.py --ids-file --apply|--dry-run --annotate

jules: I'll run dry-run against archive payloads: `python tools/replay_refunds.py --ids-file ./ids.txt --dry-run --rounding=bankers`

claire: Dry-run results: 17 processed -> 17 corrected_amounts differ by total 2.83; NetSuite candidate apply_ids in ./dryruns/rounding-fix.csv

finance-bot: [auto] approval-request total=17 total_adjustment=2.83 requested_by=claire

support: Need customer-facing note? For amounts < $1 we usually include in monthly statement, but finance wants outreach if invoice already paid and adjustment > $0.10.

claire: Only 5 invoices exceed $0.10. Finance to confirm wording. We'll wait for accounting approval before real apply.

hamid: Patch PR#644 merged to canary. Will deploy to prod after approvals. Also adding a linter rule to prevent integer-division on money fields.

ops-bot: [auto] canary deploy payments@v1.4.4 started

jules: After patch, we'll run replay with `--annotate=rounding_fix_2026_02_20` and `--idempotency=refund_event_id` to avoid duplicates.

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job queued job_id=rounding_fix_2026 eta=2026-02-21T03:15:00Z

finance-bot: [auto] approval-granted approver=accounting lead=marie scope=5_invoices_over_0.10 action=apply 12_invoices_under_0.10 action=defer_notify

claire: Running replay in 5m. Will post artifacts and NetSuite apply IDs once done.

ops-bot: [auto] payments@v1.4.4 deployed to prod by hamid at 2026-02-21T03:12:30Z

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job started job_id=rounding_fix_2026 status=running

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job completed job_id=rounding_fix_2026 applied=5 annotated=12 total=17 failures=0

claire: All applies succeeded. CSV with ns_apply_ids uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/replay/rounding_fix_2026/applies.csv. Finance confirmed balances reconcile.

jules: Follow-ups: (1) add rounding unit tests and linter, (2) add alert for rounding delta > $0.05, (3) include a note in runbook about multi-refund handling.

support: I'll draft customer note for the 5 with >$0.10 adjustments and coordinate sends.

finance-bot: [auto] incident-closed handled_by=payments team_id=pay_21 reconcile_id=rounding_fix_2026
